plan.notes: Sources (all official, retrieved 2026-09-30): (1) the official CMU Undergraduate Bulletin 'Mechanical Engineering Major, B.S.M.E.' page for all 72 major hours (66 required + 6 electives) with codes, titles and credits; (2) the official CMU 2025-2026 bulletin University Program group pages and Competencies pages for gen-ed. EGR 477 Finite Element Analysis and EGR 371 Robotics and Automation selected for the 6-hr elective requirement (from the approved list). EGR 190QR satisfies the Math/QR competency. GAP: the bulletin snippet did not include separate Mathematics/Science (MTH/PHY/CHM) requirements beyond the EGR courses; verify with an advisor as ABET math/science sequences may add hours. Writing Intensive: EGR 489WI + EGR 499WI in the major plus ENG 234WI + HST 222WI in the UP. SEMESTER ARRANGEMENT IS A CONSTRUCTED SAMPLE SEQUENCE - CMU's official Major Map PDFs are auth-gated; an advisor should verify. At least 30 EGR credits must be taken at CMU. 72 major + 9 competencies + 27 UP = 108 specified; free-elective choice slots (12 cr) reach 120.
